notes: Access: direct Chrome navigation worked throughout, no WAF/challenge; robots.txt has generic Disallow: / with explicit Allow for /, /products/, /collections/ etc, no Claude-specific block. Site is a headless Next.js storefront over Shopify (same platform confirmed in the prior Home-Decor archive c273 for this SR). No top-level 'Furniture' nav item exists in the mega-menu (departments are Bedding, Furnishings, Kitchen, Dining, Decor, Kids & Children, Organisers, Rugs & Carpets, Bath, Garden, Gifts) - furniture lives entirely as a sub-branch named 'Accent Furniture' inside the 'Decor' department, alongside Wall Decor, Artificial Plants, Lamps, Showpieces, Planters. Tree source: mega-menu (found the Accent Furniture entry point) + each category page's own sub-category tile strip (the KARE-style pattern from brief 7b#1) walked recursively: Accent Furniture(1844) tile strip -> New Arrivals(excl,marketing)/Accent Chairs/Tables/Stools,Benches&Ottomans/Shoe Rack/Mandir/Premium Home Accents/Bar Stools; Accent Chairs(374) tile strip -> Office Chairs/Accent Chair(edit)/Lounge Chairs; Tables(679) tile strip -> Coffee Tables-Center Tables/Bedside Tables/Metal Coffee Tables(excl,material filter)/Side Tables/Wooden Coffee Tables(excl,material filter)/Nested Coffee Tables; Stools,Benches&Ottomans(1058) tile strip -> Bar Stools/Benches&Stools/Ottomans&Pouffes; Benches&Stools(472) tile strip -> Benches/Stools; Ottomans&Pouffe(491) tile strip -> Ottomans/Pouffes/Set of Two(excl,qty-pack variant)/Christmas Ottomans&Pouffes(excl,seasonal). Also cross-checked the two collection sitemaps (sitemap_collections_1.xml + _2.xml, 3183 URLs total) with a furniture-keyword scan to find anything the tile strips missed - this surfaced nothing additional in scope (see exclusions below) and confirmed no /collections/sofas exists (real 404 'Collection not found', this platform 404s honestly rather than silently serving a parent). Counts: every leaf's 'N Products' rendered header was cross-checked against its own real pagination (last ?page= link) via ceil(N/20)=lastpage, mirroring the exhaustion method validated in the prior Home-Decor pass for this exact site (fixed 20/page grid) - all leaves matched exactly, no discrepancies found. Sanity check on overlap: Coffee Tables/Center Tables(299)+Bed Side Table(21)+Side&Bedside Table(377)+Nested Coffee Tables(85)=782 sums to more than parent Tables(679), confirming (as in the prior pass) that sibling collections on this site use overlapping tag-based membership rather than strict partitioning - each is still a genuine, separately-clickable node with its own real count, so each was kept as its own row rather than assumed additive. Exclusions: vendor/brand-listing pages (Doe & Buck, Ikiriya, India Circus, Jabrix, Jodhpur Craft, Krishna Handicrafts, Manor House, Nestroots, Riance Creations, Essenza Maison, Creator Handicrafts, Clasicraft, Artisans Alley, Couchly, Skanda Fab, Sourcing India, Symplify, The Table Fable, The Wishing Chair - all per NEVER-EXTRACT brand/designer listing rule); material-filter pages (Metal Coffee Tables, Wooden Coffee Tables, Marble/Solid Wood/Modern Accent Furniture); marketing/seasonal pages (New Arrivals Accent Furniture, Christmas Ottomans & Pouffes, Fast Delivery Racks & Shelves/Table Essentials, Festive Table Essentials, Racks & Shelves New Finds/Top Trends); quantity-pack variant (Set of Two Ottomans & Pouffe); Chair Pad (a cushion/textile accessory, not furniture); Premium Home Accents (320 products) - excluded as a mixed cross-category price-tier roll-up whose own tile strip shows it spans Bedside Table + Accent Chairs + Shoe Rack, i.e. a curated subset cutting across already-counted categories, same 'mixed roll-up: drop don't pad' treatment as Barware in the prior Home-Decor pass; Racks & Shelves (576) and its Corner/Wall/Floating/Hanging Shelves variants - opened and sampled, contents are small stainless-steel/MDF storage racks, kitchen countertop risers, multipurpose organizers and wall-mounted decorative shelves, not freestanding furniture shelving/bookcases, so excluded per the Shelving Line and standalone-storage-product rules; Table Companion (619) - opened and sampled, contents are wooden tissue-box/cutlery holders (tableware accessories), not furniture; The Beige/Blue/Green/Grey Sofa Edit - opened and sampled, contents are cushion covers colour-matched to sofas ('Cushions For Beige Sofa'), not actual sofas - confirms the site does not sell sofas at all; Hammock (11) - opened and sampled, contents are cotton macrame TOY hammocks for kids/decor, not furniture hammocks. Kids furniture: searched the full collection-sitemap for crib/nursery/kids-bed/kids-desk/kids-chair/kids-wardrobe/highchair/glider terms - only kids bedding/textile collections and a kids-desk-organisers (accessory, not furniture) collection exist, no standalone kids furniture facet, matching the prior pass's finding that Kids Room Decor is a mixed textile/toy roll-up with no furniture facet. Outdoor/garden furniture: searched for patio/outdoor-chair/outdoor-table/garden-bench/lounger/deck terms across the full sitemap - no results beyond Hammock (excluded above as a toy item), so no outdoor furniture exists on this site. Dining furniture: the 'Dining' nav department resolves to dining-table-decor (table linen/runners/mats), not furniture; no dining-table or dining-chair collection exists anywhere in the sitemap scan. Ambiguous item flagged: Mandir (48 products, e.g. 'Amrit Pooja Home Mandir', 'Ishvara Spiritual Home Mandir') - these are physically freestanding MDF/wood cabinet-style home-temple units, i.e. furniture by PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE, but serve a religious/spiritual purpose not explicitly named in the brief's include/exclude lists; included as a furniture cabinet with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than silently guessed. Live-but-empty category retained per brief 7b: Wardrobe Racks (0 products, real page, empty-state text present) emitted as a normal leaf with qty=0.
